keyframes.source: 4. Baker sets a ball of dough on the workbench nearest us.
keyframes.state: The single ball of dough now rests on the near edge of the wooden workbench, nearest the camera. Baker’s hands are empty.

first: Fixed, eye-height wide view from the opposite pavement, squarely facing the shop’s front wall. The quiet street has pale stone paving, muted brick, and gently weathered painted wood beneath a blue, sunless sky. One shop glows on the right side of the street; its large, clear front window is on the left, and its blue glazed door is on the right, with the shop-name sign mounted at adult chest height. Through the window, baker stands behind the wooden workbench, holding one plump, pale-cream ball of dough with a slightly flattened base. Thin, irregular patches and tiny specks of white flour dust baker’s apron. One flour bowl rests at the far-left end of the visible worktop. No other characters are present.
